newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Birch says tax discussion deferred.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Birch says tax discussion deferred.

text.p: New Zealand Minister of Revenue Bill Birch on Friday announced a deferral of the International tax - conduit issue and trading stock tax policy discussion documents.
Birch said the documents would need to be deferred until at least February 1997.

On August 8, the then ministers of finance and revenue announced that a discussion document on the issue would be released later in 1996. A discussion document on trading stock was also scheduled for release before the end of the year.
Birch said the deferral would allow the new coalition government time to consider the issues prior to the release of the discussion documents.
